title: Final Frequencies
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expressions for the vibration frequencies omega_+, omega_-, and omega_0.

title: Weak Field Limit
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive and state the frequencies in the weak field limit.

title: Strong Field Limit
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive and explain the frequencies in the strong field limit accurately.

title: Lagrangian Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly set up the Lagrangian for the system considering both electric and magnetic fields.

title: Matrix Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly formulate the matrix equation from the equations of motion.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the equations of motion or incorrect assumptions about the fields.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Physical Interpretation
description: Optional Criteria: The student should provide a clear physical interpretation of how the electric and magnetic fields affect the oscillation frequencies.
